claim_boundary: This seed records public OPAI facts and a LumenCore expression of interest. It does not prove accepted membership, endorsement, pilot selection, private-data access, or external validation.

engagement_expectations.workshops: approximately 24 hours per year; participant travel expense

working_group_details.name: Use Case
working_group_details.public_mandate: Catalog and prioritize use cases by member value, feasibility, and risk; identify existing solutions or projects; use sandboxes that protect data and IP.
working_group_details.lumen_core_entry: Submit the EIA-930 replay-validation lane as a bounded use case with pre-registered acceptance rules.

working_group_details.name: Domain-Specific Model
working_group_details.public_mandate: Develop power-sector models using governed high-signal data and benchmark performance over time.
working_group_details.lumen_core_entry: Contribute model-vs-baseline evaluation, hash manifests, negative-result retention, and offline verification.

working_group_details.name: Data Sharing
working_group_details.public_mandate: Enable responsible data sharing, develop contractual templates and security mechanisms, and define transmittal, storage, anonymization, aggregation, and synthetic-data practices.
working_group_details.lumen_core_entry: Use the buyer-authorized held-out data contract and explicit rights labels before any utility replay.

working_group_details.name: Implementation
working_group_details.public_mandate: Share scaled-AI lessons, publish case studies and deployment guidance, streamline use-case deployment, and develop playbooks or roadmaps.
working_group_details.lumen_core_entry: Translate an independently verified replay into a bounded pilot playbook without claiming deployment or savings.

member_representative_committee.role: Coordinates consortium activity and member participation across work groups.
member_representative_committee.organization_seat: Each member organization designates one representative, typically its head of AI or equivalent.
member_representative_committee.public_meeting_cadence: Monthly on the third Wednesday from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM ET.
